environment.description: Application deployed in ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action BLOCK, (2) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with default action BLOCK and sensitivity level set to HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task's security group only permits inbound traffic from the ALB's security group on port 8080 (no direct internet access to the container). The ALB listener on port 443 forwards to the target group after WAF evaluation. CloudWatch logging is enabled for the WebACL with sampled requests stored for 30 days.

config.network: ALB -> ECS task; task SG allows inbound only from ALB SG
config.logging: CloudWatch WAF logs with sampled requests
config.tls: ALB listener on 443 with ACM certificate
